title: Episode title — Solo Travelers Get Taxed, Airlines Fight the CDC, and Boeing's Backlog Stretches Into the 2030s
summary: American and United are quietly charging solo flyers more than groups on the same flights — we dig into who's doing it and who isn't. Plus, airlines are furious about a new CDC Ebola rule landing next week, the Airbus and Boeing order backlog is now so deep that a plane ordered today won't show up until the mid-2030s, and South African Airways can't make payroll even after selling off its Heathrow slots.
